title: Awoodda Aan La Dhiibin
intro: Dhulalkii hore, maamul awood leh ayaa mar xukumi jiray, isagoo maamula kheyraad aad u badan iyo nolosha dad aan la tirin karin. Iyadoo ay jiraan calaamado iyo digniino cad, haddana taliyahani wuxuu doortay waddo diidmo ah, taasoo horseeday iska hor imaad qoto dheer oo soo noqnoqon doona waqti ka dib.
clues: Waxaan sheegtay awood iyo awood buuxda oo aan ku leeyahay dhul ballaaran.
Waxaan la tartamay rasuul is-hoosaysiiya oo uu soo diray Rabbiga boqortooyooyinka oo dhan.
Dadkaygu waxay caan ku ahaayeen inay si fiican u yaqaaniin qaab-dhismeedyada waaweyn iyo webiga ilaaliya ilbaxnimadeenna.
Waxaan goob joog u ahaa calaamado badan oo mucjiso ah, oo ay ku jiraan ul isu beddeshay abeeso iyo gacan dhalaalaysa.
Waan diiday inaan koox addoonsi ah ka tago dhulkayga, inkastoo amarrada Ilaah ay jiraan.
Raacitaankaygii dadkii baxayay ayaa aniga iyo ciidamadayduba ku keenay bartamaha bad kala qaybsan.

arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَـٰفِلِينَ
verse: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them. (7:136)
